column1: # checks of the gate at 4.2.3, before Lineage 31 (gate backlog_gate_v1_78_0.sh): kind, name, digest of the probe with the restriction argument and version numbers removed

column2: == Validation cache proof — the per-shape cache and the split change no verdict ==
== Self-proof of the register path — the plumbing, not the shapes ==
== Lineage-completeness gate — absence is reported, not assumed away ==
== Fixture-coverage gate — every shipped fixture is exercised ==
== New-shape proof — does every shape authored since last publish cite its fixture? ==
== Clause proof — which constraints has a fixture made fire? ==
== Criterion artefacts — does the thing each criterion names exist? ==
== Number origin — does every figure say where it came from? ==
== Adoption — is any capability shipped and required by nothing? ==
== Self-application — does any checker report on a graph it never read? ==
== Reachability gate — no class the vocabulary cannot point at ==
== Lineage-order gate — did the chain come before the work? (git witness) ==
== Archive integrity and archive shapes — retirement lost nothing, and the archive holds what a retired record must hold ==
== Lineage ordinals — every lineage holds its own place in the sequence, live register and archive together ==
== Archived lineages — recorded stage digests: no unseen failure (ratchet) ==
== Lineage 19 probes — each rule fires on a planted fault and each refusal holds ==
== Flow points against the commits that recorded them (G115) ==
== Archival finder — achieved lineages are found, and archiving is the next activity ==
== Manifest-digest carrier — the root of the covered set lives outside it ==
== Manifest-coverage gate — nothing on disk is unexplained ==
== Version-freeze gate — did any versioned file's content change under its own frozen name? (G94) ==
== Release-item-accounting gate — does this release own the items it moved, or say it didn't? (GOV-S01) ==
== Lineage-discipline gate — the document's claims match the suite ==
== Determinism gate — same register in, same answer out ==
== Distribution-drift gate — is the public copy current? ==
== Doc-coverage gate — does the standard still describe the subject? ==
== Promoted-overlay gate — does the severity audit derive an overlay from the shapes? ==
